prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a white-washed limestone terrace wall with blue trim at the top, some plaster cracks and climbing flowers
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a WIDE HORIZONTAL pixel-art game texture strip, 2:1 aspect ratio, of ONLY the straight-on vertical FRONT FACE of a raised terrace wall as viewed in a top-down JRPG map. The wall face occupies the ENTIRE frame edge-to-edge, no background and no ground visible. Seamlessly horizontally tileable: geometry, trim, flowers and color at left boundary join perfectly with the right boundary. Top ~6%: thin sunlit warm off-white stone rim with a continuous muted blue ceramic trim line beneath it; DO NOT show the upper horizontal surface. Main wall: worn whitewashed limestone plaster, subtle irregular stonework and a few crisp plaster cracks; restrained climbing vines with sparse tiny flowers, distributed so much of the wall stays visible. Face gently progresses from creamy warm yellow-white highlights at top to muted lavender/red-purple shaded off-white near bottom. Bottom ~8% continuous darker mauve slate contact band; no floor. Neutral soft even overcast illumination from upper left, NO cast shadows, nighttime, lamps, glow, vignette, or light pools. Premium modern HD JRPG pixel art, hand-placed hard-edged pixels, ~256 x 128 logical art pixels enlarged by uniform integer nearest-neighbor scaling, every pixel a crisp identical square, clusters of 3–10 logical pixels, 4–6 shades per material, rich earthy hue shifted palette. Strictly no anti-aliasing, gradients made only of discrete pixel clusters, blur, noise, photographic texture, soft brushes, checkerboard dithering, outlines, figures, or objects in foreground.
